title: Pizza Party

serves.summary: The learner cuts whole pizzas into equal slices and deals them so every friend gets the same amount with none left over, which shows that a fraction a/b is a divided by b (3 pizzas for 4 friends is 3/4 each; 5 for 3 is 1 2/3 each).

request.objective: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b) by sharing wholes equally, including shares less than and greater than one whole (5.NF.B.3).

problems.ask: Share the 3 pizzas fairly among 4 friends. Use up all the pizza.
problems.goal: Every slice is on a plate and each friend has the same amount: 3/4 of a pizza (for example three quarter slices).

problems.ask: These 2 pizzas come cut in halves. Share them fairly among 3 friends, with no pizza left over.
problems.goal: The pizzas are re-cut so the slices deal evenly, and each friend has 2/3 of a pizza.

problems.ask: Share 5 pizzas fairly among 3 friends. Use up all the pizza.
problems.goal: Each friend has 1 and 2/3 pizzas (5/3) and nothing is left on the counter.

problems.ask: Share 4 pizzas fairly among 6 friends. Use up all the pizza.
problems.goal: Each friend has 4/6 = 2/3 of a pizza (thirds, sixths or any fair mix pass).
